about.title: Mynbha Bhoomi-Drishti
about.subtitle: Geo-AI Platform Jingïatylli Jingkyrpang Pyrthei bad Jingïalam Jingsngew
about.problemText: Ka India ka lyoh ïa kajan pyrthei naduh ka bynta ka jingkyrpang saw snem. Katba na mynta ka jingïatylli ka dei ban leit da lympung, bha shisha bad hapoh jingjop, kumta ka jingïalam ka la don dei mynno ka jingkyrpang ka la sngew hapdeng ka pyrthei.
about.solutionText: Ka Bhoomi-Drishti ka pynïaid ïa ka jingpeit satellite bad jingïm pyrthei bad ka RUSLE model, jingïatylli jingbam um, jingïalam kein bad ki jingïalam sngewbha — namar ka pynla ïa kito ki rong na ki khynnah shynrang.
about.footer: Prototype ba la thoh na ka Smart India Hackathon 2026. Ki jingdon bad ki scenario ki long ki demo dataset.
